root_idea.summary: The root centers on remaining, enduring, and persisting in existence, in contrast to perishing.
root_idea.development: The basic notion of duration extends to what remains as a remnant, preserving or sparing something, waiting or keeping watch, and religious works or provisions whose benefit endures. Classical descriptions distinguish what endures in itself from what endures through another cause, and what remains in substance from what remains only in kind.

senses.definition: To remain, continue, last, or endure.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a thing, person, or state that continues in existence rather than perishing.

senses.definition: To spare, leave alive, or refrain from destroying entirely.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction لا تُبْقِي, the subject is said not to spare or leave its object unconsumed.

senses.definition: More lasting, more enduring, or longer continuing.
senses.usage_conditions: A comparative or evaluative adjective describing greater duration or permanence.
The active participle may describe what continues to exist or what survives after others have ceased to exist.

senses.definition: Remaining, enduring, or constituting a continuance or surviving remnant.
senses.usage_conditions: In فَهَلْ تَرَى لَهُمْ مِنْ بَاقِيَةٍ, it can denote continuance, a remaining group or person, or a remnant; the feminine form may also function as a noun of continuance.

senses.definition: Enduring righteous works whose reward or benefit remains.
senses.usage_conditions: In البَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ, the expression denotes good works or religious acts whose recompense or fruit endures, not merely a physically surviving object.

senses.definition: A remainder, remnant, residue, relic, or remaining portion.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of what is left over or preserved from something; the Quranic occurrences include a material remnant and a remaining portion or benefit.

senses.definition: People possessing excellence, sound judgment, discernment, religious integrity, or obedience.
senses.usage_conditions: In أُولُو بَقِيَّةٍ, the noun describes people characterized by excellence or understanding; some explanations emphasize their religious obedience or their guarding themselves from punishment.

senses.definition: A lawful or good remainder preserved by God, and, by extension, a religious observance through which God's reward is sought.
senses.usage_conditions: In بَقِيَّةُ اللَّهِ, it may denote lawful sustenance remaining after honest measure and avoidance of what is forbidden, a good condition preserved by God, or religious obedience and service directed toward His recompense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look at, watch, observe, or wait for someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive usage meaning to keep something or someone under observation or to await them; it is distinct from the intransitive verb meaning to remain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause to remain, preserve, perpetuate, retain, or reserve something or a portion of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes preserving an asset in its existing state, leaving a portion for later use, and—especially with عَلَى—sparing, pardoning, or showing mercy so as to preserve a person or relationship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Preservation, sparing, quarter, mercy, or compassion that lets a person live or preserves affection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive associated with asking to be spared or shown mercy, including an appeal for quarter after defeat.
A reciprocal construction describing two or more parties continuing in one place or association.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The best or choicest part of a people, family, or company.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In expressions such as مِنْ بَقِيَّةِ القَوْمِ or بَقِيَّةُ القَوْمِ, the term refers to those selected as the most excellent, as though reserved from what a people produces.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Forbearance or restraint from seriously marring an existing bond of amity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational use describing mercy or restraint that preserves unity or affection between parties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The net produce or amount remaining from a kharāj tax or a similar assessment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use referring to the yield left after the relevant dues or calculation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More sparing, merciful, pitiful, or compassionate toward one's people than another person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative idiomatic use based on showing greater preservation or mercy toward others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One that retains some of what it holds or supplies.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a she-camel that retains some milk, horses that reserve some of their running, and places that retain some collected water rather than exhausting it.

cautions: The QAC Form I group بَقِيَ includes the supplied surface أَبْقَى at 53:51:3, glossed contextually as “He spared.” The direct lexical evidence for sparing belongs to the Form IV entry أَبْقَى; that occurrence is therefore not reassigned as an independent Form I sense.
أَبْقَى occurs as both a Form IV verb and a comparative adjective in separate QAC form groups; these are displayed as distinct public forms despite their identical undiacritized spelling.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The occurrence 53:51:3 is grouped by QAC under Form I بَقِيَ although its supplied surface and contextual gloss indicate أَبْقَى meaning “spared.” Because the packet supplies no secure Form I lexical evidence for that transitive sense, it remains flagged rather than being silently added to the Form I definition.
